title: Judge a reported completion's unfinished required child after the mixed-graph checks in folder import
outcome: Judge a reported completion's unfinished required child after the mixed-graph checks in folder import
acceptance: In folder admission, a reported completion's required_child_unfinished refusal is applied only once the pass's mixed graph and durable checks pass, as open_descendants is, so a required child the graph checks refuse never holds its parent's completion or, through it, an ancestor's reported disposal
A behaviour test covers the folder that cancels P, reports P's child Q complete and adds R, a required child of Q closing a cycle only in the mixed graph: Q is applied, R refused, P cancelled
A behaviour test shows a parent's disposal applied when only its added child is refused for a cycle that does not pass through the parent
The Reported disposal docs sentence on additions the graph checks refuse matches the behaviour
